objective: A concept for a new lion variant, the Shadow Lion (legendary, twist speed; redesigned once as an ink-black lion with a bone mask and green glowing ribs), as a Blender model draft and render, with comparison sheets of the Lion and Sun Lion. Concept only: not wired into the game until its model is built and uploaded by the workflow. The three lions are rebuilt as chunky faceted low-poly cats with a mane of crystal blades, to match SHANNON's Sun Lion reference (decision 0050).
acceptance_criteria: The Shadow Lion renders from four sides in the draft build and reads as a lion variant distinct from the Sun Lion
StationConfig and StationAssets are untouched until the model is baked, uploaded and SHANNON approves the variant
verification: Full Blender 5.2 build of creature_lion (2262 tris), creature_lion_sun (2244) and creature_lion_shadow (2890), well under budget; four-view renders compared with the reference. The manifest was restored after the test builds, so the game's models and StationAssets are unchanged. Not done: a build for the upload, the upload, how the new shapes animate in the game, the StationConfig variant.
notes: Checkpoint for SHANNON: approve the faceted style and the Shadow Lion. The rig pieces and joints are the same, but the leg shapes changed, so attack and walk clips need a look in the game. Whether the other animals follow the style is open.
